topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing key themes in cancer evolution and defining the learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal expansion in pre-malignant tissues.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the evidence for hierarchical stem cell models of tumor initiation across different tissue types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and stromal codependency work alongside cellular mutations to enable malignant progression.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the experimental and computational technologies used to map mutational timing and spatial cell interactions in human tumors.

topics.label: Synthesis of multi-factorial cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic alterations, cellular origin, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model of tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the final concluding remarks and previews the upcoming lecture topic.
